comment: Reading the past is one of the easiest FYS classes. Dr. Drell is very kind and available for extra help. The reading is very light would reccommend for freshmen.

Very fun teacher and has a great personality. There is a lot of reading for FYS Reading the Past, but she understands that not every will be able to read. Argument essays were the hardest part of the class for me, at times it feels like your opinion is wrong - you must provide a lot of evidence if you have a different opinion. 
Would take again

MY QUEEN! Dr. Drell is a wonderful human and provided such a good foundation for writing papers in college. I was in her FYS Reading the Past, and I actually despise reading. Seriously...the last book I read was Diary of A Wimpy Kid. That being said, I had to read in her class, but I actually enjoyed the readings. I heart Drell

Dr. Drell is one of my favorite professors I've had at UR. She is super passionate about what she teaches. She is hilarious and her class was always one I looked forward to going to. She is very understanding and knows we have a lot more going on outside of this class. The reading homework was manageable but if you don't do it you can get by easily

Be prepared for lots of long readings, she never calls you out in class so you can get by class with not reading the books. 2 big essays and a final all very doable you just need to stay on top of the essay. She likes talking so going to office hours and making yourself known helps your grade.

Dr. Drell is kind of eccentric. Can be mildly entertaining or really annoying depending on what mood you're in. However her FYS is extremely easy and you only need to brush thru the reading/sparknotes to get by.

Dr. Drell is very intelligent and very clearly loves her subject. There is a lot of reading assigned, but the discussions can be interesting. She is a tough grader on essays, although she gives a lot of feedback on them. I did think this class was going to be more English-based, but it was taught more as a history class.

She is a very intelligent, but she does not realize that this class is a first year seminar and she grades extremely hard. I am surprised I even passed. Also, there is so much work to do for this class that it is insane! In general, if you want a really hard class with tough grading, then she would be your perfect fit.

Dr. Drell is an amazing professor! She is extremely knowledgeable, funny and passionate. She is genuinely interested in helping make sure you fully understand the material. I would recommend taking any class that she offers. They are by no means easy, but most classes you learn in aren't. Totally worth the work though (lots of reading).

Readings are incredibly boring and slow, but all are explained well in class. She'll call on you randomly if you don't participate much, and has high expectations for papers. She's very entertaining and helpful though, but we seemed to go over the same things every day and it got a bit tedious.

wonderful teacher. extremely knowledgeable in topics covered. cares about the students. easy to approach and always willing to help. its quite a bit of reading but you will become a good writer in her class. absolutely love her. 100% recommend but you will have to do your work.
Very knowledgeable woman. Good teacher. Makes you do drafts. Lots of reading.

Dr. Drell is incredibly helpful and will meet with you if you need help. She's engaged in the class, keeps it fresh and upbeat, and legitimately cares about whether her students are learning or not. Superb teacher.

Professor Drell is an awesome core professor. She seems intimidating at first, but she's nice and really cares about her students. She'll always make time for you outside of class and she's really willing to help you improve. Tough grader, but fair. She is also extremely intelligent. You won't be disappointed with her class!
Very nice professor, but oh my goodness is she boring.  Maybe it was just the topic (Medieval Frontier Societies), but I've never been so bored in a long time.

I hated core and she certainly made me respect her for her ability to both connect with and help me personally, along with not failing me for openly despising core and being an allaround terrible student. Great lady.

Professor Drell is very funny and her passion for the subject is felt through her lectures.  I thought it was funny that someon made a comment that she isnt as scary as she wants students to believe because thats really true.  Although she is a hard grader, once you realize what she is looking for, it is easy to improve.

Professor Drell is pretty amazing.  She's not one of the Core professors who doesn't know what she's talking about, so her class can be challenging, but it's also usually interesting.  She does a great job of leading discussions without being intimidating, and she's willing to work with students who want to improve their work.

Dr. Drell is a great teacher, not that you can change who you have for core, but she's not half as scary as she wants you to believe she is.  Be careful about grammar and clarity, she will correct you.  For the most part, she is a true intellectual who is highly intriguing and helpful to her students!

Professor Drell is amazing.  I had her for Core (a class most people hate), but our class always had interesting and intelligent discussions.  She is truly engaging.  She will challenge you, but not unfairly.  I am registered for an 8:15 AM History class with her next semester (even though I hate history) just to have her again.

Prof Drell is a really nice woman and shes pretty funny. Her class was pretty interesting even for an 815 history class. Shes a fair grader and really helpful when you go ask her questions. I'd take another class from her if I was a history major.

I gained the utmost respect for Dr. Drell. She is easy going, yet challenging. She finds class discussion important but doesn't make you feel guilty for not speaking up. Read texts closely and interpret with justification and you'll do well.

Such an amazingly bright woman. She's a fairly tough grader -- your papers will look like red ink bombs blew up on them. But she's incredibly engaging and she actually makes class discussions pretty interesting. Couldn't have asked for a better Core teacher.
